hpdi.title: H-P-D-I self-assessment
hpdi.subtitle: Leaders assess the organisation's digital maturity across four spaces: Human, Process, Data, Intelligence.
hpdi.forbidden: Only unit and department leaders can use this page.
hpdi.intro: Each question has 5 levels: pick the one that best describes what actually happens in the organisation today, not what you would like. A space's score is the average of its questions. Next to each space are figures Signet measures from the organisation's own data, for comparison.
hpdi.disclaimer: The questions were written by the Signet team, based on the H-P-D-I definitions in the OLP 2026 theme introduction and the DX-OS course book (sources at the bottom). This is a self-assessment tool, not an official government index, and it does not convert to a DTI score.
hpdi.managerNote: Department leaders can answer and see the result in this browser; only the unit leader saves results and sees the organisation's measured figures.
hpdi.fill: Fill in from the last saved run
hpdi.evidenceNone: Signet has no measured figures for this space in the organisation yet.
hpdi.evidenceHint: The organisation's figures when the page was opened, to compare with the answers; they are not used for scoring.

hpdi.focus: {space}: the lowest score in the part of the foundation that is not yet solid. Strengthen this space before investing in the later ones.
hpdi.focusLast: {space}: the lowest score; the three foundation spaces before it all score higher. This is where to invest next.
hpdi.focusNone: All four spaces are at level 5: keep the pace and reassess regularly.
hpdi.gapsNone: None: no later space is ahead of the one before it.
hpdi.gapsHint: Following the linear evolution principle H → P → D → I: a later space built on an earlier one that is not solid easily turns into “garbage in, garbage out”.
hpdi.saveHint: Each save is one row in the organisation's history and one audit log entry; it cannot be edited or deleted. The system recomputes the scores from the answers.
